description: This file appears to be a shell script used to test the functionality of Git notes commands, including adding, editing, copying, removing, and listing notes, as well as handling various edge cases and configurations.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Verifies that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Checks that a command succeeds and satisfies the test.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with the expected status code.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Ensures that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes multiple lines to a file for testing.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets a Git configuration key for testing.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test completes.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a file or output.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the testing script.
